## Specific task description

Task instruction: Pick the fan with small round shape and set it on the Lime mat facing the robot.

Task description: Move the small white round fan at the center of the table to the bright yellow-green square mat on the left side of the image, with its front facing the robot.

Success criteria: Place the fan near the center of the bright yellow-green mat, base down and body upright, with the base resting on the mat and the fan front facing the robot. Both grippers must be open and release it.

## Execution tips

- Consider gripping the middle of the protruding white housing behind the fan head, contacting opposite faces while avoiding the rounded end, thin grille edge and stand joint. Open slightly wider than the grasp section to reduce slipping and interference.
- Before closing, use the visible gap to confirm the fingers are actually on opposite sides of the housing. Avoid having one finger press against the fan head while the other is unsupported; adjust the approach angle if visibility is poor.
- During reorientation, keep the base off the table and allow rotation clearance for the fan head and outer base, avoiding the rear white storage basket or dragging the mat. Distinguish orientation from the front grille and rear housing positions.
- Slow the base as it approaches the mat. Release only after the base is supported steadily to avoid tipping or shifting when one corner lands first.
